memos.scout:
The strongest honest case for buying ECTF is thin, and I wouldn't put a $20 ticket on it.

The best data point is recent demand: 295 buyers and 19.17 SOL bought over the last 15 minutes, against 13.64 SOL sold, with the price still up 0.7% and no drawdown from the 30-minute high. The pool is deep at about 1,597 SOL, so a $20 round trip should see only modest impact.

But the brief marks this as an operator-backed coin, and the 2-minute post-graduation data is the problem. Roughly 1,500 SOL was bought by 27 wallets, with the top 5 buyers taking 99.9% and a launch bot present. That's exactly the pattern where the "demand" in the last 15 minutes may be the operator's own distribution or coordinated flow rather than organic interest. A sell-to-buy ratio of 0.0002 at launch and top-3 curve share of 100% point the same way. Operator-backed coins have averaged roughly break-even at best, and the recent 295-buyer flow doesn't escape that concentration.

Verdict: no clear case. The apparent demand is not independent of a concentrated holder base, so I'd skip.
